project: PUMA Prompt 7 - causal bottleneck and natural generalization
primary_question: Why is absolute performance still low despite Gaussian UNI2 gains, and what smallest interventions can substantially improve it?
strict_rules: Prompt6 confirmation and locked-natural holdouts are historical diagnostics only; never tune Prompt7 on them.
Use new group-disjoint natural calibration/test for confirmatory Exp1/2.
One mechanistic variable per experiment; no HPO sweeps.
Report fixed10 and supported metrics plus class precision/recall/predicted counts.

seed_replication.policy: run seed17 first; seed29/43 automatically execute unchanged only after the primary intervention gate passes; Exp3 and Exp5 are intrinsically three-seed mechanistic studies
